definitions.gloss: the button used to turn an electrical device on or off
definitions.explanation: The hardware or on-screen button that switches an electronic device's power state. Found on computers, smartphones, televisions, game consoles, and other electronics. Often marked with the universal power symbol (⏻).

examples.japanese: {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧。
{電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}しない→反応する：20204_hannousuru⟧。
{電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{3秒|さんびょう}⟦{長押|ながお}し→長押し：28889_nagaoshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{再起動|さいきどう}→再起動：09222_saikidou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: If you hold down the power button for three seconds, the device will restart.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機種|きしゅ}→機種：13211_kishu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本体|ほんたい}→本体：13033_hontai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{右側面|みぎそくめん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: On this model, the power button is located on the right side of the main body.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧ (power source; electrical power) + ⟦ボタン→ボタン：02963_botan⟧ (button, from English). A straightforward loan-compound used in product manuals, customer support, and everyday tech-support conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧: to press the power button
- {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{長押|ながお}し→長押し：28889_nagaoshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to hold down the power button
- {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ / ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to turn the power on / off (via the button)
- {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{効|き}かない→効く：01932_kiku⟧: the power button isn't working
- {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{2秒|にびょう}{間押|あいだお}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to press the power button for two seconds

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧: electrical power; power source
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to turn on (a device)
- ⟦{電源|でんげん}→電源：04429_dengen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to turn off (a device)
- ⟦{起動|きどう}→起動：18262_kidou⟧: startup; boot
- ⟦{再起動|さいきどう}→再起動：09222_saikidou⟧: restart; reboot
- ⟦{強制|きょうせい}{終了|しゅうりょう}→強制終了：14854_kyouseishuuryou⟧: forced shutdown
- ⟦{長押|ながお}し→長押し：28889_nagaoshi⟧: long press; holding a button down

USAGE:
Instructions commonly combine {電源|でんげん}ボタン with verbs like ⟦{押|お}す→押す：02854_osu⟧ (press), ⟦{長押|ながお}し→長押し：28889_nagaoshi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (hold down), and ⟦{押|お}し→押す：02854_osu⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧ (keep pressing). In troubleshooting, the phrase {電源|でんげん}ボタン⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{10秒|じゅうびょう}⟦{長押|ながお}し→長押し：28889_nagaoshi⟧ (hold the power button for 10 seconds) is a common instruction for a forced shutdown.
